acquisition: LC-MS/MS analysis using Advance LC (AMR, Tokyo, Japan) and Q Exactive (Thermo Fishser Scientific)
quantification: Analysis of the precipitates by silver staining resulted in the appearance of bands specific to HCT116
enrichment: Immunoprecipitated proteins were separated by sodium dodecyl sulfate polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis and silver-stained
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
workflow_hints: pull-down assays were performed using antibodies against DNMT3a and DNMT3b

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used an AP-MS approach (immunoprecipitation of DNMT3a/b) followed by SDS-PAGE and silver staining to identify interacting proteins. While the authors discuss potential glycosylation of RBM14 in the discussion, there is no evidence that the MS search was configured for glycopeptide enrichment or specific PTM site analysis; it was a discovery-based identification of bands from a gel.

cell_lines: Human IEC lines Caco-2 (derived from epithelial colonic adenocarcinoma) and HCT116 (derived from epithelial colonic carcinoma)
Another human IEC line SW480 (derived from epithelial colonic adenocarcinoma)
scope: Nuclear extracts containing 200 µg of protein were reacted with anti-DNMT3a (64B1446, Novus Biologicals, Centennial, CO, United States) or anti-DNMT3b (52A1018, Novus Biologicals) antibody
Immunoprecipitated proteins were separated by sodium dodecyl sulfate polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis and silver-stained
The stained bands were excised from the gel, destained with PierceTM Silver Stain for Mass Spectrometry (Thermo Fisher Scientific), and reduced and alkylated, followed by tryptic digestion
Nuclear extracts prepared from HCT116 and SW480 cells were immunoprecipitated with anti-DNMT3b antibody.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically targeted proteins interacting with DNMT3b via immunoprecipitation from nuclear extracts of HCT116 and SW480 cell lines.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (LC-MS/MS) specifically compares the interactome of DNMT3b between two human intestinal epithelial cell lines (HCT116 and SW480) that differ by the epigenetic (methylation) state of the TLR4 gene. While the broader study discusses gut microbiota and siRNA knockdown, the MS analysis itself is a pairwise comparison of these two cell lines.
